reuse.why: The #fixed rule is added to the existing shared categoriesForMonthBudgetAction filter that all month-wide actions already call, rather than re-implemented per action.

duplication.why: The same notes join and group_notes column/type are pasted into six near-identical category queries (five per-action copies plus getBudgetData), extending the existing query duplication instead of consolidating it.

placement.why: The decision lives in the month-budget-categories module and the data fetch stays in actions.ts, matching the tree's layering, though the tag regex is inlined rather than in a notes/tag helper.

scope.why: Only the helper, its test and the queries feeding it change.

maintainability.why: Single rule definition is easy to own; the six repeated query edits are a minor maintenance tax for any future group-level field.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/month-budget-categories.ts categoriesForMonthBudgetAction: the #fixed group-notes test is added once to the shared filter used by every month-wide action (setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg, copyPreviousMonth); callers only supply group_notes via their queries.
